title: Research Framework
headline: How Atra analyzes complex systems
lead: Our method rejects linear description. We decode the structural architecture of socio-technical systems so decisions can be made with eyes open.

sections.title: System Dynamics & Feedback Mapping
sections.lead: Urban gridlock, economic stagnation, and infrastructure collapse are driven by feedback, not isolated incidents.

bullets.label: Reinforcing loops (R)
bullets.text: Vicious cycles where symptom management accelerates collapse.

bullets.label: Balancing loops (B)
bullets.text: Constraints that try to stabilize behavior, and where delayed regulation fails.

bullets.label: Delay analysis
bullets.text: Temporal gaps that create false signals for decision-makers.

sections.title: Signal vs. Noise
sections.lead: When data is unstable, the challenge is not scarcity — it is that everything arrives at equal volume.
sections.body: Instead of asking which headline is true, ask: if this data is true, which decision I make today becomes meaningless?

bullets.label: Real novelty
bullets.text: Has a new variable entered the map?

bullets.label: Convergence
bullets.text: Does it align with other weak signals?

sections.title: Living with Multiple Futures
sections.lead: Most decisions assume tomorrow continues today's line.
sections.body: Scenario work is not better prediction; it stress-tests today's choices across parallel worlds — from deep crisis to limited opening. When rules keep changing, the art is keeping several paths alive at once.

sections.title: Low-Regret Decisions
sections.lead: The hardest part of deciding under uncertainty is how fast information goes stale.
sections.body: The exit: choices that minimize damage even in worst cases and preserve the right to pivot. Small experiments, multi-purpose skills, and never locking all resources into one bet.

sections.title: Paradigm & Mental Model Diagnostics
sections.lead: Systems run on the mental models of their designers. We interrogate those assumptions.

bullets.label: Illusion of randomness
bullets.text: Remove labels like unprecedented or accidental; reveal structural outputs.

bullets.label: Goal reversal
bullets.text: Expose short-term optimizations that destroy long-term viability.

bullets.label: Constraint shifting
bullets.text: Show how linear fixes move bottlenecks instead of resolving them.

sections.title: Strategic Foresight & Scenarios
sections.lead: Foresight at Atra maps the structural boundaries of possibility. It does not sell a single prediction.

bullets.label: Induced demand
bullets.text: Track how behavior nullifies technical interventions.

bullets.label: Interdependency cascades
bullets.text: Evaluate how disruption in one domain spreads non-linearly into others.
